title: Puharich courted by dark occult groups

tellings.quote: tells a story in a lecture much later in his life about how he was always approached by these you know, what he would call kind of dark occult groups

plain: The researcher Andrija Puharich, the subject of an episode calling him a CIA scientist who contacted an alien council, said he was always being approached by what he called dark occult groups. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells this from a lecture Puharich gave late in his life, which would mean secretive groups were trying to draw him in.
